_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series Z1XYW/2 SET-2. 27 page images (cover announces 27 printed pages; last folio 27): idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index 3-25 (each the Hindi of the page after it). Odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet: all Hindi, no English spill-over; idx 26 is English (Q39 only). Every English page read at full size. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 x1 (Q17-20 Assertion-Reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-11, footer X_086_31/2/2 on every page) for a bare OR: Q21, 23, 29, 33, 34, 35, 37(c), 38(c), 39(c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Q22, Q24, Q26, Q27 and Q36 carry parts with NO OR, so each is one row; the scheme labels Q31 '(a) (i)' and '(b)' but the paper prints Q31 as one question with no OR. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived, all 20 agree (Q18 carries the same arguable-but-accepted flag as 31/2/1 Q20). No void, grace or either-of-two note anywhere in the scheme (only the conditional 'Award full marks if data not written but calculations are correct' under Q29(a) and the 'deduct 1/2 mark' notes under Q32 and Q36). No decimal point is printed anywhere on the English pages (the scheme prints a raised dot in Q39 '1·5V'). Sibling of 31/2/1: 43 rows are the same questions, reshuffled and renumbered, and carry its stem/context/options/answer/chapter/subtopic/difficulty byte for byte, each confirmed on this paper's page; 11 rows (Q1, 4, 6, 17, 22, 25, 26, 27, 30, 32, 36) are not in 31/2/1 nor in any committed 2023-2025 Science paper and were transcribed fresh. Every _figure was written from this paper's own pages.
